subject: Renewal options — commit increase, term extension, and burst band
messages:
From: Leah Park <leah@focalapps.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal conversation — hosted API commits and term options

Hey Vanessa,

We’re coming up on our anniversary with Redwood (July 1) and I wanted to start the renewal conversation. Usage has grown faster than expected — we hit a new peak in May — so the team is evaluating a higher monthly committed tier plus an option to extend the term from 12 to 24 months if that helps with pricing.

High-level ask: can you share what a 2x and 3x commit uplift would look like (monthly tokens and committed price), available burst bands, and any term-extension discounts? Also need a refreshed SOW we can circulate with procurement.

I attached the May usage export for context.

Thanks,
Leah
Sr. Product Ops, FocalApps
[attachment: usage_report_May2027.csv (CSV, 120KB)]

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Leah Park <leah@focalapps.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-21T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal conversation — hosted API commits and term options

Hi Leah — thanks for the heads up and the usage export, that helps. Quick summary of what we can provide and next steps: 

- Pricing sketches: 2x commit = baseline commit * 2 with a 7% volume discount; 3x commit = baseline * 3 with a 12% volume discount. Exact $/token rates depend on model mix — I included a breakdown below.
- Burst bands: we can add a monthly burst cushion of 25% or 50% on top of the committed throughput, bill-at-usage above cushion at a moderated overage rate.
- Term extension: 24-month term yields an additional 4% list discount on top of commit tier pricing and a 60-day price protection window.
- SOW: attached a draft SOW with updated commit quantities and an optional burst addendum for procurement review.

Attachments: FocalApps_SOW_v3.pdf

Proposed next steps: can we do a 30-minute sync this week with your procurement and engineering leads to confirm the model mix and finalize numbers? I’ll loop Marissa for commercial and Priya for post-sign operational commitments.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
[attachment: FocalApps_SOW_v3.pdf (PDF, 78KB)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-22T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Renewal conversation — pricing and ops checklist

On behalf of Vanessa — putting a quick internal checklist here so we have alignment before the customer sync:

1) Confirm baseline commit (current monthly committed tokens) and exact model mix (gpt-like vs emb-only); Priya to validate telemetry for May.
2) Generate two commercial scenarios: (A) 2x commit / 12m term / 7% discount; (B) 3x commit / 24m term / 16% effective discount (12% + term). Provide ARR, monthly committed spend, and overage rate assumptions. (Marissa)
3) Draft burst-band language: cushion levels, measurement window (30-day rolling), and emergency burst cap with alerting & opt-in. (Karthik)
4) SOW tweaks: include a clear on-ramp schedule for commit increases (30-day notice), rollback clause for sustained >120% of commit for 3 months, and procurement-friendly IP/data clauses. (Priya)

I’ll prepare the commercial deck fragments and run numbers with finance; Karthik can propose the operational limits and how we’ll surface alerts in Console.  

Marking this as priority for the week — we should be ready to present by Wed 2027-05-26.

— Marissa

From: Leah Park <leah@focalapps.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Snyder <tom@focalapps.com>
Date: 2027-06-07T15:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal conversation — commit increase + term extension

Vanessa,

Appreciate the draft and your team’s breakdown. FocalApps wants to move forward with Option B (3x commit + 24-month term) pending final legal on the SOW. Two asks before I route to procurement: 1) can you confirm the effective $/token and monthly committed spend in USD with the 16% applied, and 2) add a 45-day price protection clause instead of 60 (our legal prefers shorter windows).

If you can get me a DocuSign-enabled SOW and a finalized commercial summary by EOD Monday, I’ll circulate to procurement and aim for a signature mid-next-week.

Thanks — Leah
Sr. Product Ops, FocalApps
